metadata.signupDescription: 14 days of every feature, no credit card required.

google.inAppBrowser: Google sign-in doesn’t work inside LINE, Facebook or Instagram. Open this page in Chrome or Safari first.

login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your restaurant
login.linkSent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once, and only in this browser.
login.newHere: New to Favornoms? <link>Start a free 14-day trial</link>

errors.otpExpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Links work only once, and some mail apps open them automatically. Sign in with your password below.
errors.accessDenied: That sign-in link is no longer valid. Sign in with your password below, or request a new link.
errors.exchangeFailed: That link was opened in a different browser from the one that requested it. Sign in with your password below.
errors.missingCode: That link was incomplete. Sign in with your password below.
errors.link: That access link is no longer valid.
errors.wrongPassword: Wrong email or password. If you signed up with Google, use “Continue with Google” above. If you have never set a password, use “Forgot password?” to create one.
errors.googleCancelled: Google sign-in was cancelled. Try again when you’re ready.
errors.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn’t finish. Try again in the same browser.

signup.title: Start your 14-day trial
signup.subtitle: Full access to everything. No card required.

trial.everyFeature: Every feature unlocked — delivery, AI Suite, the lot
trial.oneBranch: One branch, no menu-item or order limits
trial.noCard: No credit card, no charge if you walk away

signup.confirmBody: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to finish setting up your restaurant — then sign in with the password you just chose.
signup.googleInstead: Email not arriving? If {email} is a Google account, continue with Google instead — no email needed.

errors.passwordTooShort: Use at least {min} characters for your password.
errors.mailLimit: Our mail server is over its sending limit right now. The first link may still arrive — otherwise try again in a moment.

forgotPassword.title: Set a new password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We’ll email you a link to choose one. Use this to set your first password too.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If {email} has an account, a reset link is on its way. Open it in this browser — the link is tied to the one that asked for it.

updatePassword.welcomeSubtitle: One last step and your account is ready.
updatePassword.resetSubtitle: You will use this to sign in from now on.
updatePassword.expiredBody: Reset links work once and only in the browser that requested them. Ask for a fresh one and open it here.

errors.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email address first — open the link we sent you.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too easy to guess. Choose a stronger one.
errors.samePassword: Choose a password different from your current one.
errors.invalidEmail: That email address doesn’t look right. Check it and try again.
errors.linkUnavailable: We couldn’t send a sign-in link to that address. Check the email, or sign in with your password.
errors.emailNotSent: We couldn’t send email to that address right now. Please try again later.
errors.signupDisabled: New accounts can’t be created right now. Please try again later.
errors.accountExists: That email already has an account. Sign in with your password or with Google, or reset the password.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.reauthenticationNeeded: For your security, sign in again before changing your password.
errors.googleUnavailable: Couldn’t open Google sign-in. Please try again.
